title: Rest in Peace Post-Earnings Announcement Drift
one_line: Post-earnings announcement drift has been non-existent for large stocks since 2006 and has only recently disappeared for microcaps — prices now absorb surprises on the announcement day.

findings.statement: PEAD gone for large stocks since 2006; recently gone for microcaps.

reported_results.headline: Post-earnings announcement drift has been non-existent for large stocks since 2006 and has only recently disappeared for microcaps — prices now absorb surprises on the announcement day.

tradable_edge: Strong evidence against the PEAD stock specs (pead_long, pead_next_announcement, pead_*): treat them as parked.
data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 3), not by the weekly pipeline.
